comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Treated as the star attraction of the recently released Cargo King Mystery Bottle (available on 7/22). According to OGP:

"The new cargo king. A gigantic transport ship with massive cargo. It is also heavily armed and can be used as a battle ship due to the high durability, armour, crew and battle related ship skills."

Requirements:

Adventure: 24
Trade: 44
Battle: 36

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Cargo_King_Mystery_Bottle

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
High quality rigging + Mast Top -> High Lookout
Galley + Money chest -> Paymaster Cabin
Money chest + Special Ship Hold -> Camouflaged Hold
Infirmary + Antifouling paint -> Sanitation Room
Workshop + Money chest -> Manufactured Item Storage
Admiral's cabin + Munitions chambers -> Improved Gun Port
Casting net + Admiral's cabin -> Attack Prevention Net

It can apparently reach 1400+ cargo, if properly upgraded: uwo.ogplanet.com/en/news/update/9289.og
